observed: debug-mode captures have valid rows but communicator destruction hangs; debug_dump writes no DOT. First variant timed out; second was stopped with parent.
cause: PyTorch v2.11 CUDAGraph::capture_end with keep_graph=false and debug=true skips raw graph destruction but sets has_graph_=false; reset no longer destroys that raw graph. NCCL user objects remain live.
fix: Do not enable global debug mode. Use CUDAGraph(keep_graph=True), explicit instantiate, built-in debug_dump and reset, so ownership is explicit.
prediction: run2 and reverse-order run3 both produce DOT graphs and exit normally for all variants; original timing predictions unchanged. Exclude incomplete debug-leak run1 from conclusions.
